cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Reviewers note discontinued support, squad team killing, wobbly physics affecting aim, and low player counts.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game has a low player count, making it difficult to find active public servers or matches.

citations.review_text: Game is a hidden gem, people compare it to fortnite and PUBG but really it has its own style with unique movement, interesting weapons, and a genuinely creative map. I played this years ago with friends, haven't touched it in a while because it's basically dead. I read that there are still small numbers of players playing, but the devs stopped development on this years ago. Sad, I always thought it was a really cool addition to the battle royale genre. There is a huge wave of games nowadays called "friendslop", which are basically goofy low quality games designed to be played with friends, on the surface this seems like a BR version of that but it actually has more substance than you would think. There are different levels of armor and helmets, weapons that range from melee to explosives to other bizarre objects, even a whole bunch of crazy grenades, one of which causes a literal black hole. If only they didn't give up on it, game had tons of potential.

This is a really fun game, not too hard to pick up, with surprising depth of weapons and tactics, but it's also just wacky because you play as a gumby dude with terrible physics. This is cartoon violence done right. The only problem is the game is almost dead, can only find a public server a few days a week. Hopefully they do something to revitalize it, but for a free game I don't see why they would. 

Aiming in combat will annoy a hardened FPS player because due to the games gumby physics your guy is always pointed a weird direction and so there's not really such a thing as a predictable spray because you're wiggling all the time. That's okay though, just opt for midrange full auto hip fire and you'll do fine most of the time. Tons of weird broken guns and a lot of special ones that spawn in randomly. pro tip-abuse launch pads and launchpad grenades, the movement they provide is just silly.

Recommended, if you can find a game.

citations.review_text: Hands down the best BR I've ever played. Nothing will ever come close to epic jump + vampire with hipfiring thompson. And the TABG Barrett is the best sniper in any game ever don't even try to fight me on that one. Hard to get into full lobbies now but I am grateful for every hour I spent with my friends in this game. Still holding on to hope that the game will be resurrected one day.

I really wish more people would play this game, is makes me sad everytime I head into a lobby and there are only like 10 players, truly a game that more people need to know about. We need the fortnite players to hop on.
super fun but no one plays it. servers always start early bc they never fill up. really wish you could find & shoot guns while waiting for the match to start

This is a battle royale boiled down to a perfect mix of silly yet serious, funny and frustrating. Biggest issue as of 10/2025 is the lack of players, and the occasional cheaters. I can't tell you how many times I've gotten 2nd place to a /kill player
